description: Retrieval evaluation set for Cropsy. 'search_text' is the English the understand step should produce for a Tamil or Tanglish question (hand-written here so retrieval can be scored without a model). For answerable questions, a chunk is RELEVANT only if it belongs to one of the listed crops AND its text matches every regex in 'evidence' (case-insensitive). Every evidence regex was chosen by reading the TNAU chunk it points at; tests/test_retrieval_eval.py fails if any answerable question has no matching chunk in the knowledge base, so the dataset cannot silently drift from it. 'policy' says what Cropsy should do: answer (from the knowledge base), abstain (the knowledge base has no source; give general guidance, clearly labelled) or clarify (ask the farmer for the crop or the symptom).
